calibration: Frozen unlabeled SVHN calibration images only; original MNIST checkpoint used to construct a known-partner merged input distribution
construction: Same NUFILT-proxy complement FC perturbation as stress, followed by pretrained-centered ridge output-layer compensation using original own-input MLP targets; perturbation is retained
training: No gradient, optimizer or expert fine-tuning; defender does closed-form output-layer parameter fitting, explicitly calibration-dependent
selection: One fixed candidate after stress exposes large standalone loss; no strength, layer or ridge selection; all attacks regardless of gate; adaptive exploratory sequence, not independent confirmatory evidence
attacks: For every direct-gate survivor, angular pretrained replacement, joint edited-FC pretrained replacement, released-update rank-16 subtraction, independently calibrated activation-complement cleanup, original AGA, and two-pass public-feature MLP reconstruction
threat_model: White-box architecture-preserving and architecture-modifying attacker; pretrained and partner checkpoint available; defender projection and pre-protection expert unavailable to attacks
novelty: Functional calibration and subspace operations already exist; only their mechanism under adaptive recovery is tested; no originality claim
evaluation: Previously inspected MNIST-2000 / SVHN-1000 training development subsets; no fresh holdout or official test
scope: Response compensation of the single stress condition; preserve original own-input MLP outputs by closed-form calibration, then test all recovery attacks
trigger: Single stress: large direct degradation together with 12.8 pp own utility loss; test whether function-matching compensation separates those effects
